title: Inventory System
tagline: WPF desktop app with SQLite and multi-user support
intro: University project: a secure WPF desktop app for managing inventory with CRUD operations and audit logs.
summary: C# + XAML (WPF) with SQLite. Featured role-based login, CRUD functionality, change history, optional server mode, and DDOS protection. Automated deployment with DB initialization.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: University WPF project enabling secure inventory management with role-based access and audit logging.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a reliable, auditable desktop inventory system with role-based login and multi-user options.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Designed SQLite schema, implemented login/auth flows, built CRUD operations, added security features.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Inventory CRUD, audit/change history, role-based login, DDOS protection, automated setup scripts.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Simplified organizational inventory workflows, ensured transparency with audit logs, showcased scalable WPF dev.

sections.title: Future Plans
sections.body: Possible cloud DB integration and web dashboards (not pursued).
